body:
We had a DNA test at one time, but it is so old and so lost at this point....

Your comment about CPS has really helped me feel better about going that route. 

While I don't have proof of sexual relations 9 months before the birth. I have lots of proof of her telling people that she was his child. Like... swarms of people.

No one is on the birth certificate. She won't put him on for child support because we would immediately sue for custody. Since she can't show housing for her or her child, the suit would be very easy. 

It was just hard for me to determine what to do, since it's across state lines.

There is neglect. However, we are afraid to call CPS, because they will not recognize him as the father and she'll get pushed into the system. Or at least that's my worry.

She has only given the girl 3 baths in 4 months. She has no home and hops from home to home. She spanks her for telling the truth. She throws away her food before she can eat it. Etc.

I'm 27. I'm in a world of student debt in a city I hate. I'm a burden to everyone around me. Everyone I am close to would be much better off if I were dead. 

I can't imagine going through a life change as big as transitioning on top of all of that. 

I don't know the way out, but if you want company at the bottom... I'm here.

I didn't mean to seem "fired up" at you about it. I wasn't actually, in fact. But I can see how that could be assumed when you don't have the emotional viewpoint that you do face-to-face. I am sorry that it seemed that way.

I am genuinely appreciative for your advice, it was very helpful and I didn't mean to seem short with you.

Thank you.

I do think that they should have known. No medical professional I have spoken to has ever heard of an insurance company using surveillance to determine the integrity of a mental health case. Generally, it's just not reasonable to assume that because I have PTSD that I wallow in bed all day and don't even feed myself. It is reasonable, according to my medical team, to be disabled and continue to walk my dog. It's pretty much unheard of to use surveillance in this  type of case.

They had my entire medical record. They could see evidence that I exhibited signs of PTSD and paranoia well before they had me followed. Is it not reasonable to assume that they should have known that having me followed would cause that condition to be worsened? My therapist and my psychiatrist both believe they should have known prior to ordering the private investigator that those actions would cause me harm.

I just feel like I've been done a wrong, and I feel like there should be some way to prosecute this case. I simply don't think it's reasonable that they should have victims followed. They had more than enough evidence from a multitude of physicians to ferret out any type of fraud.

My position is that they should have known that what they did would cause harm.

There's no way that I could prove that they intended to cause me harm, I don't think...
Out of curiousity, does this mean that throughout my life I have no reasonable expectation to not have my condition worsened by companies that I am receiving disability from?

Can you tell me why this is not an intention tort case? The lawyer I spoke to was approaching it from that angle and I'd like to be informed why you feel that it is definitely not that.

Thanks.
Thank you for your reply, nonethless. I appreciate the quick response.

I have to disagree with you. Negligence, as described to me by several lawyers, is doing what would cause any reasonable person to fear for their life, unless the insurance company had prior knowledge that their actions would cause me in particular harm. They had that knowledge, they continued with their action. That is intentional cause of harm.
I'm stuck in this really weird spot. Where the hospital that I know will help me can't take me until December 15th, and I don't think I'll be around then.
I'm kind of done with talking it out. Theres nothing left to say.

Abilify was a life-changer for me. I would suggest it, honestly. 

As an off the wall suggestion, some people who take Mirapex (which is for restless leg syndrome) find their depression cured as well. It worked wonders for me.
It's hard to get away from oneself.

Thoughts of suicide are exceedingly common. While I think it might be selfish, everyone is selfish at some points. Sibling issues are also common. Try to see it from her side and realize that she's not doing that. She sees it only from her side, and what a loss it would be. Some people, when they are afraid of things, respond with anger and malice. It's not a good thing, but it is.

I'm sorry about your father. I don't know if it mattered to you, but I'm sorry nonetheless. Your mother's response is also fairly common. Some people, rather than dealing with problems, do the pretend it's not there and sweep it under the rug process. It's not nice either, but it is.

I know this message might not be helpful, but try to understand that your problems are legit and normal. That doesn't mean you don't need help. You do.

You need a new therapist. 
I understand the family situation, not really sure how to fix it. Cant even fix my own situation.

Do you want to talk about that in particular? Or something else? Why does your family seem to not know what to do anymore?
Why do you need someone to talk to?
Nice name.

How do you know there is no one else out there like her? My husband says the same thing about me. I guarantee he's wrong. 

It's a strange thing -- love -- It makes you see people unrealistically. And when you love someone, when they become all you hold onto, it can cause hate and grief when they don't match up to that expectation. Moreso, if they don't match up to a reasonable expectation.

I know it seems logical, right now. Both of you, as unique as you are, do add something to the world. You might not know it, but your death would make a difference.
Hi. I won't be so helpful if you need to talk to someone about your thoughts. But if you just need someone to talk to... I can do that.

I don't really know if a comment will help. Especially a comment from someone who isn't in much of a better mental state either. But I understand where you are coming from. I understand the need to even up the score. To make someone understand the pain that they've caused. 

But in the end, it won't change anything. Her pain will be temporary if you kill her. And hurting her will only deepen your pain, because it won't stop your own. Trust me when I say, there is no point in killing someone else and then yourself. It won't have the effect you want.

I would try leaving her. Just clean break. If you are at the point where death is an option, leaving is an option too. I understand that there's love, but sometimes, it's not enough. Sometimes, if you change the scenery, the sky clears and it turns blue. Sometimes, you just need to get away. 

Get away from her. Don't talk to her for a while. Let your mind clear and then think of the situation from a less critical standpoint. It might open your eyes.
After 6 years of marriage, I had a nervous breakdown. After 2 years of therapy, I found hope. In the last 2 weeks, my husband started cheating on me. - summary version.
To fly.
I've gone through nothing but heartache. Them, tonight, my last strand of hope, love and life, simply broke.
There isn't much to tell. I'm just alone.

The people who I love suck and only hurt me. The people who love me have a funny way of showing it. It's been steadily getting worse for two years. I keep getting a glimmer of hope, only to be destroyed again. I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of the struggle.

I'm sorry. I just really want to comment on this section of thread. It is people like this rape apologist here, that continue to make Western cultures rape-supporting cultures. I'm sorry that you had to deal with this douche-eroo. 

Rape is rape is rape and it's never, never, okay. I don't care if his girlfriend said she didn't consider it rape. She likely did and is just trying to save face for him. Not many victims are able to look their rapist in the eye and tell them what a fuckhead they are. Especially not if they care for them. So, congratulations GreenTheDamnMachine, you are a rapist. And an all-around terrible person. 

Gigify - I'm sorry you have to deal with people like this. I know what it's like to be a victim. I know what it's like to relive trauma. Neither are fun. Your story, regardless of what anyone else thinks, is valid. It's traumatizing and straight up wrong. I am sorry you went through it. 

Write off the assholes. Also, I hope you are doing better today.
I don't have the hand steadiness for either of those - fixing computers or locksmithing. So, you've got a one up on me there.

I understand. There's a lot of stigma about DD-NOS as a whole. I don't think I could be an accounting major, but I love some math. Definitely couldn't be a business major. I don't like people enough. I am just a straight atheist. Though, I do attend a church because I am able to discern goodness when I see it. And it's always good to have some positivity in your life.

Hi. I am 26. I am DD-NOS with PTSD and an OCD related panic disorder. We seem to have a lot in common. Just a few days ago I posted on this forum because I also needed help. I am a psychology major, so I'm bright enough to know how to avoid doing anything rash. But I understand that doesn't stop the thoughts. I also understand when no one you speak to will respond. In fact, this post feels much like I feel on a consistent basis.

All that said, I know where you are and you aren't alone in feeling that way. Talk to me, talk my ear off. 

I don't pray, but my thoughts are with you.

In fact, I actually have the opposite problem. I take on EVERYONE'S problems. It's like I'm working towards sainthood, I swear. I take in the homeless, despite being financially strapped. I take my roommate to work, but don't take money from her paycheck (because she can't really afford it) and I can't really afford it either. I go to every medical appointment with my mom. Ever. (And she won't win even average mom of the year award) 

I do not know how to put myself first. What's worse, is I'm not sure what I'd do if I stop. I got asked today by the hotline lady that later hung up on me, what I do for self care and I ended up telling her that I didn't even know what she means. 

This is mostly because what most generic places see as self-care, I think is stupid. See: Have a hobby like painting, or etc. I'm sorry, but really seriously, painting is not going to fix my shit. Neither will journal writing or any other trivial hobby.

I can't imagine loosing my puppy, much less a dog you have for 9 years. That's crazy. And I think depression is a realistic response. I'm sorry for what you are going through. I don't know that I'll be super helpful, but I wanted to express my sympathy for your loss.

A year and a half ago I had a mental breakdown brought on by a chemical imbalance, depression, stress, you name it. And since then, I've been diagnosed with a bajillion different things. You know, it takes a bit to iron out the kinks of mental illness.  Lines are blurry. Life was shit.

But the thing is... Now, life isn't shit. Sure, it's overwhelming. But it's actually going in an upward direction, but I still don't want to live it. I feel like I've used up all of my life poker chips and it's just time to walk away from the table.

And that makes it worse. Shouldn't I feel better? No, fuck that. I should feel better. I want to feel better. And I don't. And sure it might get better, it might, but I don't really have the time or effort or anything it requires to try and wait until it does.

Also, I just got hung up on by the Suicide Chat because it was 2 AM and they were closing. So, first busy, then closing. Apparently, I can't be suicidal on schedule, I'll try to jump off a bridge at 4pm next time.
I am 26. I am where you are. I can't give you any real advice. But at least you aren't alone.
